Luckin Coffee
Find nearby stores and order coffee for in-store pickup.
Scan with your phone to open the Luckin AI Open Platform
Sign in with your phone number and copy the MCP access token (valid for about 30 days; come back here to replace it when it expires)
Find nearby stores
Recommend and search drinks by taste
Preview prices before ordering
Place and cancel orders (in-store pickup only)
Order a coconut latte at the nearest Luckin
Payment is by WeChat QR code; this only goes as far as placing the order.
McDonald\'s
Claim coupons and order for pickup or McDelivery.
Scan with your phone to open the McDonald\'s MCP Open Platform, tap Sign in at the top right and sign in with your phone number
Tap Console → Activate at the top right, accept the service agreement and copy the MCP Token
Nearby stores, menus and meal combos
Check my points and coupons, claim available coupons
Price an order by store and pickup method
Order for in-store pickup, drive-thru or McDelivery
Track orders and see the promotions calendar
What McDonald\'s coupons are there today?
Payment is completed in the McDonald\'s app. Menu prices are for display only; the calculated price is what counts.
AMap
Find places, search nearby, plan routes and check the weather.
Scan with your phone to open the AMap Open Platform console and sign in
Create an app and add a key with the service platform set to Web Service, then copy the key
Keyword and nearby search (with ratings and addresses)
Driving, walking, cycling and transit routes
Weather
Convert between addresses and coordinates
Any highly rated hot pot within two kilometers?
Navigation itself still runs in the map app on the phone or tablet; AMap adds search and route information.
DiDi
Hail rides for family: fare estimates, booking and driver location.
Scan with your phone to open the DiDi MCP Open Platform
Tap Try now, sign in and copy the MCP key
Fare estimates
Hail now or book ahead
Order status and driver location
Cancel orders
Get my mom a ride from home to the train station; estimate the fare first
The sandbox uses simulated data and books no real rides; production dispatches real rides and charges for them.
Tencent Docs
T
Find, read and edit your online documents.
Scan with your phone to open the Tencent Docs Open Platform and sign in
Request a personal MCP access token and copy it
Search and read documents
Create and edit documents
Manage knowledge bases
Read me the key points of my weekly report

Bothy Playground is the other demo app in the repository (workspace/apps/android/bothy-playground); install and open it on this device to connect. The car and the home are made up, shown only in Playground, and control no real device.
Virtual cabin
C
A made-up car: climate, seats, windows and doors, trunk, screen and volume, ambient lights. Changes show up in Bothy Playground.
Air conditioning, temperature, fan speed
Heating and ventilation for all four seats; knows who sits where and who is speaking
Windows, doors, trunk and door locks
Center screen brightness, volume, ambient lights
Music and navigation (both made up)
Readings such as cabin temperature, battery and doors can be watched with a plan
I\'m a bit cold. Set the driver\'s seat heating to level 2
Virtual home
H
A made-up home: lights, curtains, air conditioning, door lock, robot vacuum and scenes. Changes show up in Bothy Playground.
Lights in four rooms: on and off, brightness, color
Curtains, air conditioning
Front door lock (unlocking asks first)
Robot vacuum
Scenes: home, away, sleep, movie, wake up
Room temperatures can be watched with a plan
I\'m going to bed
Kiwi.com flights
Search and compare flights worldwide, no sign-up needed.
Search flights by origin, destination and date (give or take a few days)
Compare prices, stops, duration and baggage allowance
Get a booking link and book on the Kiwi.com website
What\'s the cheapest flight from Shenzhen to Chengdu next Friday?
A public service, no key needed. Prices on the Kiwi.com website are what count; set a plan to be reminded when the lowest fare drops below a price.
DeepWiki
Understand open-source GitHub repositories: doc structure, contents and Q&A.
List a repository\'s documentation topics
Read a documentation page
Ask about a repository\'s code and design
Use DeepWiki to see how k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx does keyword spotting
A public service, no key needed; public repositories only.
Hugging Face
Search models, datasets and Spaces; see downloads and licenses.
Search models, datasets and Spaces
Repository details: downloads, likes, license and files
Which Chinese speech recognition models on Hugging Face have the most downloads?
Works anonymously, no key needed; for your own private repositories, add an access token in Settings → Connections → MCP.
Context7
Look up the latest docs and code examples for libraries and frameworks.
Find a library by name
Look up its latest docs and examples for a question
Use Context7 to look up sticky headers in Jetpack Compose\'s LazyColumn
A public service, no key needed; for heavier use, add a Context7 API key in Settings → Connections → MCP to raise the limit.
Grok Bot
Hand tasks that need your personal accounts, like sending email, research or reminders, to your own Grok Bot; the result is announced here when it\'s done.
